disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to a crime relating to dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content contrary to s. 466.019 or rules of the board adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report a person the licensee knows or has reason to believe is in violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows, or has reason to believe, is clearly in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising an unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene contrary to this chapter or to a rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being employed by any entity other than a dentist or a professional corporation/LLC composed of dentists to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being employed by any corporation, organization, group, or person other than a dentist or a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report known to be false or failing to file a required report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, knowingly impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act constituting sexual battery upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act which would constitute sexual battery, as defined in chapter 794, upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment of the patient including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination results, test results, and X rays, if taken.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make available copies of documents relating to a patient or client upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make available to a patient or client, or to her or his legal representative or to the department if authorized in writing by the patient, copies of documents in the possession or under control of the licensee which relate to the patient or client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services not duly authorized by the patient or client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client, or her or his legal representative, except as provided in ss. 766.103 and 768.13.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering controlled substances outside the course of professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the professional practice of the dentist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering schedule drugs to oneself
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893, by a dentist to herself or himself, except those prescribed, dispensed, or administered to the dentist by another practitioner authorized to prescribe them.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice her or his profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide adequate radiation safeguards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a dental office resulting in dental treatment below minimum acceptable standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operating or causing to be operated a dental office in such a manner as to result in dental treatment that is below minimum acceptable standards of performance for the community.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any licensee under chapter 458 or chapter 459 who the dentist knows has violated the grounds for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, in writing, within 30 days if action has been taken against one's license to practice dentistry in another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing by the dentist of record, before the initial diagnosis and correction of a malposition of human teeth or initial use of an orthodontic appliance, to perform an in-person examination of the patient or obtain records from an in-person examination within the last 12 months

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures. It includes the performance or attempted performance of any dental operation, or oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery and any procedures adjunct thereto, including physical evaluation directly related to such operation or surgery pursuant to hospital rules and regulations. It also includes dental service of any kind gratuitously or for any remuneration paid, or to be paid, directly or indirectly, to any person or agency.
